data_status.note: Official means operator-attested government provenance, not independent publisher authentication. Fixtures/demos are never substituted as live observations.

historical.limitations: RETROSPECTIVE RESEARCH ONLY: current government snapshot, not verified historical vintages. Feature-view availability assumes next-day 00:00 Asia/Kolkata publication. Later source revisions may be present. Metrics are conditional on this assumption, not demonstrated live/as-of performance or farmer realized-price accuracy. Artifacts cannot be deployed as validated production forecasts.
historical.rounding_note: Displayed prices/errors are rounded to INR .01; aggregate metrics use the original full-precision frozen predictions. This is historical evaluation, not a current forecast.

error.message: The selected series is stale or has insufficient recent history; inspect the dated historical evaluation instead
